description:
You have:


4+ years of experience programming in JavaScript, HTML, CSS and cross-browser development 

Proficiency in client-side frameworks such as Angular.js or ReactJS 
with an emphasis on structuring a large web UI application using 
patterns like MVVM 

A desire for keeping up with the latest and evolving web 
technologies including responsive web design, HTML5, CSS3, Node.js or 
other JS frameworks.

Familiarity with machine learning algorithms and techniques 

Exposure to Python, Apache, HAProxy, DNS, TCP/IP, C/C++, RoR, PHP or
 Java- Knowledge of build/test frameworks such as Gulp/Grunt, jshint, 
Jenkins or mocha 

Experience with writing services that use HTTP interfaces to send requests and responses to Node.js 

Understanding of Linux programming, scripting, debugging and 
performance tools on UNIX, Linux, Shell, awk or similar technologies


 Skill:    Python, Apache, HAProxy, TCP/IP, C/C++, RoR, PHP or Java- Knowledge


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
